info.about: Heavy Metal: Geomatrix is a 3D arena fighting video game released in 2001 by both Sega and Capcom for the Sega NAOMI and Dreamcast, based upon the Heavy Metal license.
info.trivia: Its licensed soundtrack features Megadeth, Halford, W.A.S.P. and Corrosion of Conformity.
info.why: Released only in arcades and on the Dreamcast under the Heavy Metal licence, the Dreamcast disc is the game's only home release.
